newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama consumer prices rose 2.3 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Panama consumer prices rose 2.3 pct in 1996.

text.p: Panama's consumer price index rose 0.8 percent in December, up from 0.3 percent in December 1995 and took inflation over the whole of 1996 to 2.3 percent the Comptroller General's office said.
December's rate was up from 0.1 percent in November while 1995 inflation was 0.8 percent.
Economists attribute Panama's low inflation to its use of the U.S. dollar as national currency and long-standing wage and price control policies.
